summary: Plain field-by-field copy of an 8-DWORD (32-byte) struct: copies a2[0..7] into this[0..7] in a shuffled order (0,2,3,4,5,6,7,1) and returns the destination pointer this. No transformation, validation, or guard. Used as a helper when inserting driver-table entries and when compacting array slots.

local_names.this: destination struct whose 8 DWORDs are overwritten
local_names.a2: source struct whose 8 DWORDs are read
local_names.result: returned copy of the destination pointer

operations.description: Take result = this so the destination pointer is returned to the caller.
Return the destination pointer this (the result).
Used by InsertDriverTableEntry (0x00418560) and ArraySlotCompactionWithGapFilling (0x00418AC0) to copy a 32-byte entry during array insertion and slot compaction.

unresolved: Meaning of the 8 copied DWORDs is not documented in this function; field roles depend on the caller's struct layout (driver-table entries / array slots).
Copy order (0,2,3,4,5,6,7,1) is a compiler artifact of the shuffled assignment sequence; no semantic ordering is implied.
